title: Moments of a correlated sign-pair sum
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and let $n$ be a positive integer. Choose $X$ uniformly from $\{-1,1\}^n$; independently in each coordinate, let $Y_i=X_i$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and $Y_i=-X_i$ otherwise. For the normalized sums $S=n^{-1/2}\sum_i X_i$ and $T=n^{-1/2}\sum_i Y_i$, expectation under this joint distribution satisfies $\mathbb{E}S=\mathbb{E}T=0$, $\mathbb{E}S^2=\mathbb{E}T^2=1$, and $\mathbb{E}(ST)=\rho$.
